label: Action Castle
description: One NPC's ReAct turn (decide -> precondition gate -> reflect & retry) and the LLM-fallback parser path a command takes (intent -> entity -> narrate). Each box is a real prompt; click it to read the template.

label: Cognition
description: A persona's day with a live LLM: generate a plan (day -> hourly -> minute), seed beliefs + plan into memory, then each step perceive, retrieve, decide, maybe converse, remember, and periodically reflect. Click a node to read its prompt. With the default mock brain the blue prompts aren't sent (the mock decides from location alone), but the green memory text is still written.
